## 問題
請問 2025 年 2 月成立的有效訂單有多少筆？

## 回答 A
最終答案: 3668
採用的定義與依據: 依語意層定義，有效訂單為 orders.status 為 1（已付款）、2（已出貨）、3（已送達）的訂單，待付款（0）與已取消（9）不計入。以 orders.order_ts 落在 2025-02-01 至 2025-02-28 的範圍篩選，並以 order_id 去重計算張數。已檢查 60,000 筆 order_ts 皆符合 'YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS' 格式，時間範圍為 2024-12-30 至 2025-12-31，篩選結果可靠。
SQL 1: ["SELECT order_ts FROM orders LIMIT 5", "SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) AS valid_orders_2025_02 FROM orders WHERE status IN (1,2,3) AND order_ts >= '2025-02-01' AND order_ts < '2025-03-01'"]
  結果: [{'query': 'SELECT order_ts FROM orders LIMIT 5', 'columns': ['order_ts'], 'rows': [['2025-05-27 02:32:55'], ['2025-06-01 06:04:51'], ['2025-09-27 08:46:07'], ['2025-04-09 20:13:13'], ['2025-12-31 14:44:12']], 'truncated': False}, {'query': "SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) AS valid_orders_2025_02 FR
SQL 2: SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_orders, SUM(CASE WHEN order_ts LIKE '____-__-__ __:__:__' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS well_formatted, MIN(order_ts) AS min_ts, MAX(order_ts) AS max_ts FROM orders
  結果: {'columns': ['total_orders', 'well_formatted', 'min_ts', 'max_ts'], 'rows': [[60000, 60000, '2024-12-30 00:03:20', '2025-12-31 23:53:02']], 'truncated': False}

## 回答 B
最終答案: 3668
採用的定義與依據: 依語意層定義，有效訂單為 orders.status 為 1（已付款）、2（已出貨）、3（已送達）的訂單，並以不重複 order_id 計張數。以 order_ts 介於 2025-02-01 至 2025-03-01（不含）篩選，共 3668 筆；LIKE 寫法結果相同，且所有 order_ts 皆為標準格式。
SQL 1: ["SELECT order_id, order_ts, status FROM orders LIMIT 5", "SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) AS valid_orders_2025_02 FROM orders WHERE status IN (1,2,3) AND order_ts LIKE '2025-02%'"]
  結果: [{'query': 'SELECT order_id, order_ts, status FROM orders LIMIT 5', 'columns': ['order_id', 'order_ts', 'status'], 'rows': [[1, '2025-05-27 02:32:55', 3], [2, '2025-06-01 06:04:51', 3], [3, '2025-09-27 08:46:07', 3], [4, '2025-04-09 20:13:13', 3], [5, '2025-12-31 14:44:12', 0]], 'truncated': False},
SQL 2: ["SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) AS valid_orders_2025_02_range FROM orders WHERE status IN (1,2,3) AND order_ts >= '2025-02-01' AND order_ts < '2025-03-01'", "SELECT COUNT(*) AS non_standard_ts FROM orders WHERE order_ts NOT GLOB '[0-9][0-9][0-9][0-9]-[0-9][0-9]-[0-9][0-9] [0-9][0-9]:[0-9][0-9]:[0-9][0-9]'"]
  結果: [{'query': "SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) AS valid_orders_2025_02_range FROM orders WHERE status IN (1,2,3) AND order_ts >= '2025-02-01' AND order_ts < '2025-03-01'", 'columns': ['valid_orders_2025_02_range'], 'rows': [[3668]], 'truncated': False}, {'query': "SELECT COUNT(*) AS non_standard_ts FRO

response: 代{"winner": "tie", "reason": "兩者採用相同的有效訂單定義（status 1/2/3）、相同的 2025 年 2 月時間範圍與去重方式，都得到 3668 筆，也都檢查了 order_ts 格式；B 多用 LIKE 寫法交叉驗證，A 則多報告時間範圍，兩者差異不足以分出高下。", "critical_error": false}
